title: Proxy agent library with unique names, single copy service, library-based scenario editing
purpose: The agent page becomes the library (proxy=True, market=NULL). Scenarios get agents either by creating a new agent (added to the library first, then copied) or by selecting a library agent (copied with plants, algorithm and fail-stack settings). All agent creation and copying is done by one service module.
depends_on: algorithm_selection_ui (for package ui: the agent form fields already exist)

work_packages.notes: New file only, so it runs in parallel with runtime_core. PLAN 2.3 names agent_service.copy_agent/create_library_agent. They live in library_service.py (ADR-005).

modify: abmem/views.py (agent_list filter, create_agent_and_related, update_agent, delete_agent, create_simulation, update_simulation, run_simulation use library_service, new check_agent_name and library_agents_json views)
abmem/services/algorithms/optimization/hyperparam_optimization.py is NOT touched (deleted by hpo.service in wave 4)

public_interfaces.description: Explicit list of copied fields. A test asserts it covers every concrete Agent field except id, market, proxy, state, source, created_at, updated_at, so a future field cannot be silently dropped (PLAN 2.1 'copy carries the field automatically').

public_interfaces.signature:
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PlantInput:
    resource_id: int
    capacity: int

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AgentInput:
    name: str
    budget: Decimal
    type: AgentType
    algorithm_type: AlgorithmType
    failstack_enabled: bool
    failstack_limit: int
    failstack_delta: Decimal
    failstack_min_margin: Decimal
    plants: tuple[PlantInput, ...]
public_interfaces.description: Validated input built by views from JSON or form data.

public_interfaces.signature:
def normalize_name(name: str) -> str
def check_name_available(name: str, *, market: Market | None = None, exclude_id: int | None = None) -> bool
public_interfaces.description: normalize_name strips surrounding whitespace (no other change). check_name_available: market None checks the library case-insensitively (Lower(name)), otherwise checks names inside the market case-sensitively, matching the DB constraints.
Validates name availability, resource rule (validate_agent_resources), capacities > 0, creates Agent(proxy=True, market=None), Portfolio, Plants. Raises ValidationError with field keys.

public_interfaces.signature:
@transaction.atomic
def update_library_agent(agent: Agent, data: AgentInput) -> Agent
public_interfaces.description: Only for library agents (ValueError otherwise). Replaces plants. Copies in scenarios and runs are untouched.

public_interfaces.signature:
@transaction.atomic
def copy_agent(src: Agent, market: Market, *, proxy: bool, name: str | None = None) -> Agent
public_interfaces.description: Deep copy of COPIED_AGENT_FIELDS, Portfolio and Plants into market. source = src if src.is_library else src.source. state reset to CREATED, budget copied. name defaults to src.name, uniqueness inside market enforced (ValidationError on conflict, OQ-14).

public_interfaces.signature:
@transaction.atomic
def add_new_agent_to_scenario(data: AgentInput, market: Market) -> Agent
public_interfaces.description: 'New agent' path: create_library_agent(data) then copy_agent(library_agent, market, proxy=True).

public_interfaces.signature:
@transaction.atomic
def clone_scenario_for_run(proxy_sim: Simulation, *, seed: int | None = None, forced_algorithm: AlgorithmType | None = None, algorithm_overrides: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None, fixed_agent_fields: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None) -> Simulation
public_interfaces.description: Replaces the deep-copy blocks in views.run_simulation and hyperparam_optimization.create_simulation_from_proxy. Copies Simulation (proxy False, state CREATED, currentPeriod -1, seed = seed or proxy_sim.seed), Market (state CREATED) and every agent with copy_agent(..., proxy=False). forced_algorithm sets algorithm_type on all copies (K7, HPO). fixed_agent_fields applies HPO fixed fail-stack settings. Requires proxy_sim.proxy True (ValueError otherwise).

public_interfaces.signature:
def check_agent_name(request: HttpRequest) -> JsonResponse
def library_agents_json(request: HttpRequest) -> JsonResponse
public_interfaces.description: GET agent/check-name?name=&exclude_id= -> {"available": bool, "message": str}. GET agent/library.json -> [{id, name, type, budget, algorithm_type, failstack: {...}, plants: [{resource_id, resource_name, energy_type, capacity}]}].

scenario_payload_contract.create_and_update: agents: list of objects. {"mode": "new", name, type, budget, algorithm_type, failstack: {enabled, limit, delta, min_margin}, plants: [{resource, capacity}]} or {"mode": "library", "library_agent_id": int}. Legacy payload without 'mode' is treated as 'new' for backward compatibility of the existing template until it is updated in the same package.
scenario_payload_contract.update_semantics: update_simulation deletes the scenario's agents and recreates them from the payload inside one transaction (current behaviour), using copy_agent for library entries.

invariants: Every agent created through the UI or services satisfies the DB constraints, server validation fails before the DB raises IntegrityError.
Editing a library agent never changes any scenario or run agent (copy semantics).
copy_agent output has the same plants (resource, capacity) and COPIED_AGENT_FIELDS values as the source.
The agent list page shows only library agents.
edge_cases: Name with leading/trailing spaces: normalised before checks.
Name differing only in case from an existing library agent: rejected.
Name longer than 20 characters: rejected by form validation.
check-name with empty name: available False with message.
Library agent deleted while referenced: copies keep working with source NULL.
Selecting the same library agent twice for one scenario: per OQ-14 (proposal: 400 and UI prevents it).
library_agent_id that does not exist or is not a library agent: 400.
Race between check-name and submit: DB constraint raises IntegrityError, converted to 400 with the same message.
test_plan: test_library_service.py: create, duplicate name in different case rejected, copy_agent equality of fields and plants, source rules (library -> copy, copy -> run copy keeps library source), COPIED_AGENT_FIELDS coverage test, clone_scenario_for_run with forced_algorithm, editing library agent leaves copies unchanged.
test_agent_library_views.py: agent list shows only library agents, check-name endpoint, create/update/delete flows, IntegrityError race mapped to 400.

test_scenario_library_flow.py: create scenario with one 'new' and one 'library' agent, verify library now contains the new agent and scenario holds two copies with correct sources, update scenario, run scenario uses clone_scenario_for_run (copies carry algorithm_type and fail-stack fields).
acceptance_criteria: PLAN 2.3 validation: duplicate library name rejected, library selection copies fully, library edits do not affect scenarios
out_of_scope: HPO evaluation cloning logic beyond clone_scenario_for_run (hpo)
